dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Need a guard? It'll cost you extra, though. Unique times and everything.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: The risks are high, after all. Meteorites are dropping from the sky — who knows what else might come down while we're at it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I'm a guard for hire. I escort goods safely from A to B. Not to boast, but in all my time doing it I've never slipped up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Might I ask your name?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Haha, I forgot to say my name.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: It's Huangshan.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I'm pretty well known on the merchants' route between Mondstadt and Liyue. I'm thorough in my work, and people so say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Forgive me for saying this, but please, no need to go easy on me!

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Brilliant! My defeat is utterly complete!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About guards-for-hire...

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: You just need to know that it's a term specific to Liyue that refers to mercenaries who specialize in protecting cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Well, the people of Liyue prize mercantilism, and traveling merchants must go far abroad. Our job is to protect them from bandits who would rob them of their goods.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I've accumulated a lot of experience from my years working in this field for — and I don't mind sharing.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Spare me the pleasantries; what is it you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Bye. I sense a certain confidence in you; we should team up some time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Might I ask your name?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Haha, I forgot to say my name.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: It's Huangshan.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I'm pretty well known on the merchants' route between Mondstadt and Liyue. I'm thorough in my work, and people so say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the rumors on the road?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: A dragon attacked Mondstadt the other day, so I'm taking a temporary break.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I can deal with monsters, beasts and bandits no problem, but I'm not trying my luck against no dragon.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Speaking of rumors, this is where the rumors of two nations meet. I'm told the staff here are all informers for the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: The look on your face suggests you took that seriously. Ahahaha...
